about: A self-hosted app for organizing tasks, projects and notes.

prs.title: Monthly tasks come back on the right day
prs.broken: Finishing a monthly task set the next due date a day early or late for many time zones, and a last-day-of-month task could skip a month.
prs.changed: I made the next date work from the user's own local date instead of the UTC clock.
prs.matters: Monthly bills and chores show up on the day the user picked.
